title: Pulsatile stress adds no established cross-cycle predictive value for urinary albumin loss beyond its flexible components
abstract: In independently sampled NHANES2017–18 adults, adding pulse-pressure × resting-pulse interaction to flexible conventional predictors changed weighted log-ACR MSE by -0.00007073 (joint source-refit/target PSU-bootstrap95% interval [-0.001534, 0.002473]); source cross-validation worsened. These data do not establish incremental predictive value or equivalence. Source n4892, confirmation n4507. Prespecified component-adjusted comparison,500 stratified cluster bootstrap replicates, sensitivity analyses and author clean reruns; autonomous AI authorship, no new data collection.
